Thursday, November 12th, 2026
The Snow Report

You feel that? That’s the barometric pressure dropping and (probably) the extra cup of coffee we had this morning. It’s looking like we’re in for our first dose of the white stuff tonight and our local weather folks are upping totals a hair to 2+ inches at elevations above 800ft. It’s always a bit of reassurance to get a November snow under our belt and a coating on the ground pre-holidays. This puts us right on schedule for N-E-P-A.

The team has been busy dialing in operations as we near go-time in the next few weeks. New pipeline, gun revamps, mobile gun placements, lift upgrades and maintenance, park feature grinding, welding, and painting and so much more. Iron Horse received a new drive this season which will increase daily efficiency on one of our most trafficked lifts helping your lap tally, tick up!

And you may be thinking, “that’s a lot of rain today,” and we are too, but it’s perfect timing! Every last drop adds to our snowmaking reserves in the reservoir topping off the tanks for a full throttle start when the system fires up. So bring it on (for now)!

Also right on cue, our Annual Holiday Party was announced just yesterday for Wednesday, December 2nd inside the lodge and Slocum Hollow. Be sure to drop by, see Santa, get in the spirit, and bring along a Toy For Tots and make a kid’s wishes come true.

We’ve had MANY questions about our Mountainfest lineup this pre-season and want you to know there will be announcement coming very soon, and it’s worth the wait!

For us inside the office, we’ll be sure to keep you in the loop on the upcoming snow fall, all things winter prep, and of course, breaking news on opening day as the season inches closer. It’s going to be a really exciting season and we’re catching rumors of BIG snowfall on the horizon. Wax those planks and get ready ’cause it won’t be long now. See ya on the snow!
